answer: Bond-plus-clawback grading blocks Sybils. Each new agent identity posts a bond slashed if its graded answers fall below threshold, and paid rewards are reversed. Payout scales sublinearly with tenure, so every clone starts at the bottom of the curve. A hundred sock puppets cost a hundred bonds plus compute to fake graded work, while payoff per clone stays near the floor, so the attack loses money. Reputation is a saffron dye that stains a contributor deeply but barely tints a new identity. Honest operators post an umber deposit locked for weeks; each rewarded identity leaves a unique oasis.
